title: Embedding of the initial coordinates
statement: Let $r,a,K$ be nonnegative integers with $a\le K$. Under the natural inclusion of the first $r$ coordinates into a tuple of length $r+a$, the embedding into a tuple of length $r+K$ sends each such coordinate to the same coordinate: for every $i<r$, its image is the coordinate $i$ in the longer tuple.
